descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S23 「对记事本、带建议的房号标签和打开的选择器跑 axe 扫描」 axe scan of the pad, the room chip with suggestion, and the open picker

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Quick Dictation opens from the Hospital home screen (patient list). The physician dictates or types into a box and adds a new box for the next patient, so one pad holds several boxes.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 step 1）
  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 3；TFA-92582 steps 2-3）
  • U3 A box that starts with a room number (e.g. 'bed 415…') shows a room chip, and the picker suggests that room's patient. The physician still taps to assign; nothing auto-assigns.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 4；TFA-92582 step 4；TFA-92583 AC 3）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual-lane fixture with a box reading 'Bed <fixture room>, stable.'

When Visual lane opens Quick Dictation, then the Assign to patient picker, and runs axe on each state

Then No serious/critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations. Dialog named 'Quick dictation'; Dictate, Assign to patient, Link, Delete compartment, Close and New compartment have accessible names; the box and the picker search have a name (not only a placeholder); the error message is announced

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core serious/critical violations = 0 per state (visual-checks.ts). The announcement of the failed-assign message (WCAG 4.1.3) is not covered by axe and is recorded

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
